title: Operation
description: One Action, performed by one actor on one target. It inherits the Action's contract. A workflow is written over Operations, so the same Action can appear in it twice with different performers.

id.description: Kebab-case. Unique among the Operations of its behaviour document. all is reserved.

target.description: What it is performed on. Defaults to the Action's entity.

actionRef.description: An Action in this behaviour document, or behaviour/action for one in a behaviour document this one uses.

entity.description: An entity id in the described domain, or domain/entity for one in a domain it uses.

instance.description: One named instance of that entity, such as a specific team.
